label: Every NECESSARY_2 actual concretum is an actual root of the selected grounding relation
paraphrase: OPEN (NAR, analyst formulation, unattributed): every concrete being that exists at w and at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2, NecessaryAt) has no actual concrete ground at w in the selected grounding relation, i.e. is an actual root. The denial of 'necessary through another' for modal necessity; it is not about the tertia via's NECESSARY_3/NECESSARY_4 (a being necessary in that sense may have its necessity from another). Constructively equivalent to: whatever actual concretum (concrete, existing at w) has an actual concrete ground at w is not NECESSARY_2 at w; with excluded middle, such a concretum is contingent at w. The unrestricted form over all beings is strictly stronger. Compatible with the sourced statement 8c3870b7 (ST I q.44 a.1 ad 2, some necessary things have causes of their necessity) only if that statement is read as NECESSARY_3/NECESSARY_4. Its rival is a NECESSARY_2 actual concretum with an actual concrete ground (Avicenna's necessary through another, whose causal version bears on NAR only through the esse-cause bridge cb1cdea9; note section 4).
